source_and_caveats: FCC 11-188 (Dec. 22, 2011), paras. 1, 15: $1.925B for six D Block licenses (6 MHz nationwide) and five E Block EA licenses (6 MHz in NY, Boston, Philadelphia, LA, SF). Coverage column makes MHz-pops = 6 x 2010 U.S. pop + 6 x E Block EA pop. Used for supplemental downlink. 700 MHz low band: likely overstates 1.7 GHz.
